evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Rep asks 'Is this Jacqueline?' and uses name throughout (Jacqueline, used multiple times)
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'would take about ten to fifteen minutes' but no explicit promise of dependable quote or wait for yes
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked — rep jumps directly into logistics probing
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concerns raised by customer, so no opportunity for two-layer follow-up
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection of customer concerns given
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: Rep mentions '$2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse, any accidental damage' and 'all of the wrapping, all of the furniture will be wrap and protected' but does not frame as formal promises or use permission lead-in. No mention of On-Time Guarantee at all.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No 'Does that put those to rest?' or 'How do you feel about that?' asked
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening: No concern-led opening asked. Rep launches into logistics from previous form data instead.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Rep asks 'typically for a one bedroom apartment. There's about fifteen to 25 boxes. Do you think you're gonna fall within the range?' and customer clarifies she only needs heavy items moved. Box count addressed.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep mentions 'Friday is one of our discounted days' (value days), states 'Everything's included there gas truck taxes and insurance' and 'there are no hidden fees or extra charges' (fee transparency). Does not mention pricing contrast with competitors or Cameron's no-notes line explicitly, though does say 'I'll send everything to your email so you wouldn't have to take notes.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides specific hourly rate ($206 for two movers) and total estimate ($690 for 2.5 hour minimum) personalized to partial move of heavy items only
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep identifies Friday as a discounted day and provides hourly rate ($206), but does not give total dollar savings or ask about date flexibility
evidence_quotes.prep_and_temperature_check: No Save Your Ass prep framing given. No temperature check ('How do you feel about that?') asked.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep never asks 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or equivalent. Conversation ends abruptly after estimate.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' asked
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep never mentions rate lock, no deposit, or asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' Rep instead transitions to sending estimate and does not attempt to close
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: No booking attempted. Customer and rep both say goodbye without any commitment or booking details

top_strength: Dana gathered comprehensive logistics details efficiently (addresses, room inventory, box count, floor level, destination unit) and confirmed all key move parameters before quoting.
coaching_note: The call skipped the two core discovery moments entirely — never ask the two-concerns question to uncover what matters to the customer, and never attempt to close with an explicit ask for the business; this is what turns a quote call into a booking call.
